correctness.rationale: Schatten Hölder gives \(\|[A,B]\|_r\le2\|A\|_p\|B\|_q\), hence the universal lower bound. For normal \(T=U|T|\), the commuting split \(X=U|T|^{r/p}\), \(Y=|T|^{r/q}\) satisfies \(XY=YX=T\) and \(\|X\|_p\|Y\|_q=\|T\|_r\). Tensoring with a rank-one factorization \(P=[C,Z]\) gives \([X\otimes C,Y\otimes Z]=T\otimes P\). A finite-rank normal operator on an infinite-dimensional separable Hilbert space is unitarily equivalent to \(T\otimes P\), and the same holds for normal compact targets with infinite-dimensional kernel. The Brown--Anderson trace obstruction and rank-one construction give the stated strict existence threshold for nonzero positive finite-rank targets.
